hero.title: Ahmet Büken
hero.subtitle: Master of Wooden Handicrafts & Phaetons
hero.description: Discover the timeless beauty of handcrafted wooden carriages, intricate ornaments, natural woodwork, and classical craftsmanship from Balıkesir.

about.title: The Last Representative of Traditional Craft
about.description: Based in the Havran district of Balıkesir and known as the 'Master of Horse Carriages and Phaetons,' Ahmet Büken is a living treasure of traditional Turkish handicrafts with half a century of experience. Resisting modern production techniques, the master works entirely with traditional methods. Each piece is completed with meticulous handcraftsmanship over an average of 6-8 months. These masterpieces keep nostalgia alive across the Edremit Gulf and tourism regions, while Master Ahmet takes pride in passing this fading art form on to new generations.
about.quote: "To touch wood is to speak with the heart of nature. Passing this art to new generations is my greatest goal."
